why: `dispose` no longer unsubscribes from popstate, so a mirror the HUD has torn down keeps handling the browser's Back on behalf of an owner that no longer exists -- popping layers on a dead stack and re-pushing the sentinel through a `back` callback whose HUD is gone. Fails 1 of 15 in navigation.test.ts: `dispose unsubscribes popstate and never traverses; with no host every call is inert and active is false`, at its `host.listeners` length assertion.
